name: parichehrvn_tcn_fall
description: Fall detection using fine-tuned YOLOv11-Pose for 17-keypoint extraction and a Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN) on 15-frame sliding windows for temporal classification (ADL vs Fall).

model_info.architecture: YOLOv11-Pose (keypoint estimation) + Temporal Convolutional Network (TCN, dilated Conv1d)
model_info.training_dataset: Custom fall detection dataset (YOLO pose fine-tuned, TCN trained on ADL/Fall keypoint sequences)

confidence_threshold.description: Minimum TCN softmax confidence to classify as fall (below this triggers fall_warning)

seq_len.description: Number of frames in TCN sliding window (must match training window size)

frame_skip.description: Process every Nth frame (1 = every frame, higher = faster but less accurate)

gpu_support.notes: YOLOv11-Pose + TCN inference benefits from GPU via PyTorch CUDA
